d: Israil men naee sarkar ke gathan ki kavayad ke bich arab rajnitik dalon ne purv sena pramukh gadi aaizankot ko samarthan dene ka faisla kiya hai. rashtrapti isak harzog ne bhi unhen sarkar banane ke lie aamantrit kiya hai. halanki, aaizankot ki nitiyon ko lekar bhi falastin samarthak halkon men saval uthte rahe hain. vah binyamin netanyahu ki vor kaibinet ka hissa rah chuke hain aur falastin ke mudde par unki nitiyan bhi sakht mani jati hain.
